notes.f1: Not recovered at all. No John William Spriggs anywhere in the final tree, and no father relationship to Reuben Spencer Spriggs. The run never named a parent or claimed a connection to Reuben. The research was directionally sound as far as it went -- it worked the 1910 and 1915 North Dakota censuses and correctly eliminated the Fred Sprigg household of Albert Township, Benson County, noting no Reuben Spencer among its seven indexed members -- but it was cut off mid-verification of a 1915 candidate and asserted nothing about parentage.
notes.f2: Not recovered at all. No Charlotte Marie Westby in the final tree and no mother relationship. The only adult woman present is Nora Alvina Satter, Reuben's wife, who was already in the starting tree. As with f1 the run made no claim about a parent before it ended.
